title: Microservices Recipes: The Architect's Field Guide
description:
Version 2.1 of Microservices Recipes: The Architect's Field Guide, a 23-chapter field guide on microservice boundaries. It presents Adaptive Granularity Governance (the Khan Microservice Pattern) and the RVx Index. Chapter 11 is the only source of truth for the formula.

Dual license: MIT for source code; CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 for prose, diagrams, and figures. The GitHub handle vaquarkhan is an identifier, not the display name. The author is Viquar Khan.
